sections.title: Overview
sections.body: Fleet Operations replaces fragmented tools with a single platform for vessel scheduling, crew coordination, voyage tracking, and performance. Designed for operators who need clarity across the portfolio — not another generic dashboard.
bullets: Live vessel and voyage status across the fleet
Crew planning tied to vessel rotations
Performance signals that ops teams can act on

sections.title: What you get
sections.body: Modules are assembled around your workflows — from noon reports to commercial handoffs — so the platform fits the desk, not the other way around.
bullets: Compliance checkpoints in the flow of work

sections.title: Who it’s for
sections.body: Built for fleet managers, marine superintendents, and ops desks that run mixed fleets and need one reliable source of truth.
bullets: Owners and managers with multi-vessel fleets
Ops teams coordinating shore and ship
